text:
Marcos: Heads-up: planning a canary deploy for service-x v2.4.0 tonight at 23:00 UTC. Strategy is filtered-sample -> fractional ramp: 1% (30m) -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (60m). Using the new traffic filter to keep noise low. Who can own deploy and smoke?

Priya: I can own the deploy and run smoke. I'll be on from 22:45. Smoke checklist command: `./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env canary` — will paste results here.

Ashley: Cohort selection to confirm: filtered-sample will pick users with `user_tag in (beta,eng)` and exclude heavy-IO customers (`account_tier != enterprise-high-io`). We're allocating US-WEST + EU-CENTRAL as the initial cohort regions.

Ben: Quick ask: do not include APAC in the first 20% window — we've seen bursty retries there. Also make sure we route to the quantized model variant for canary to keep cost stable.

Marcos: Rollback plan: immediate traffic cut to 0% and pin back to v2.3.9. Command: `redwoodctl rollout set-traffic service-x 0 && redwoodctl deploy pin --service service-x --version v2.3.9`. We'll run a dry run of that command at 22:50.

Priya: Alerts we'll watch: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR error budget burn > 10% in 15m OR p50 latency > 200ms. Oncall: Emily (I ping her below). I'll enable an incident short-circuit channel if we need an immediate rollback.

Emily: I'm oncall and will monitor. Setting temp alert thresholds now. Notes: if streaming SSE disconnects spike after ramp to 5%, consider toggling streaming=false for canary traffic.

Ashley: Good call. We'll start with streaming disabled. After 20% stable for 60m, we'll enable streaming on a small subset (2% traffic) to validate.

Ben: Dashboard and logs: https://console.redwood/dashboards/canary-2330012345 (dash has error-rate, tail-latency, kv-cache hit rate). Also bump DB pool by +10 for canary workers to avoid connection saturation.

Marcos: Timeline recap: 22:45 - deploy team boots; 23:00 - start 1% canary; 23:30 - advance to 5% if green; 00:00 - start 20% ramp window; 01:00 - hold for decision to continue. If any gating alert fires, we'll cut to 0% and execute rollback. Ping @oncall + post in #eng-releases when changing traffic. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for service-x v2.4.0 has been queued and will start at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. Audit ID: rdw-canary-2330012345.

Priya: I'll paste smoke outputs after 22:50. Also asking SRE to have a hot rollback ready (Ben, can you pre-stage the previous infra config?).

Ben: Pre-staging infra and pin config now. Will confirm when done. :white_check_mark:

Marcos: Thanks team. If anyone can't make the window, call out now. Otherwise we'll proceed as planned and post short status updates in-thread during the ramp.
